item.text:
**7B.6 Research Note**

Bottom line: mostly yes, with real caveats. Scholz’s 2024 record shows repeated public defense of press freedom, public questioning, parliamentary and judicial channels, and no proven criminal findings on the major allegations. The main counterevidence is that the Warburg/Cum-Ex and 5G files remained partially opaque, and the intelligence-oversight framework was structurally weak.

**Accepted claims**

- [Rede von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz zum 75. Jubiläum der Deutschen Journalistenschule](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-journalistenschule-2290636) · Bundesregierung · 4 Jun 2024 · Scholz said investigative reporting and critical distance are essential to democracy and explicitly praised free, independent, diverse media. This is direct evidence that he tolerated scrutiny by independent journalists. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.2`.

- [Rede von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz beim 70. Gründungsjubiläum des BDZV](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2309104) · Bundesregierung · 15 Sep 2024 · Scholz again defended free press, said critics should challenge politics, and argued that journalism’s critical distance is necessary. This supports a permissive posture toward independent reporting. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.2`.

- [Scoop: nonprofit Correctiv sparked huge pro-democracy protests all over Germany. How did they do it?](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/news/scoop-nonprofit-correctiv-sparked-huge-pro-democracy-protests-all-over-germany-how-did-they) · Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism · 5 Apr 2024 · The Reuters Institute reported that Scholz publicly amplified Correctiv’s anti-far-right investigation, which is evidence that he did not treat investigative journalism as a hostile act. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.2`.

- [Strafanzeigen gegen Mitglieder der Bundesregierung](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1014366) · Deutscher Bundestag · 31 Jul 2024 · The Bundestag reported that multiple criminal complaints against Scholz and other ministers did not lead to investigations because there were no sufficient factual grounds. This undercuts claims that he used office to block formal legal scrutiny. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.4`.

- [Germany says no political decision made on sending Taurus to Ukraine](https://theprint.in/world/german-minister-says-no-political-decision-made-on-sending-taurus-to-ukraine/1989822/) · Reuters · 5 Mar 2024 · After the Taurus leak, Pistorius said there was no political decision to send Taurus and called the breach an individual mistake, which is evidence of public correction rather than a defensive cover-up. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.2`.

- [Cum-Ex-Untersuchungsausschuss Scholz weist weiterhin jede Einflussnahme zurück](https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/innenpolitik/scholz-cum-ex-ausschuss-100.html) · tagesschau.de · 6 Dec 2024 · Scholz again denied political influence in the Cum-Ex/Warburg affair; the report says no proof of influence emerged, but it also records persistent “memory gap” criticism. This is mixed evidence: he allowed questioning, but did not fully dispel suspicion. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.4`, `7B.2`, `7B.1`.

- [Bericht: Regierung vertagt Entscheidung über strengere Vorschriften im 5G-Netz](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) · Reuters via onvista · 23 May 2024 · Reuters reported confidential interministerial talks and ministries declining public comment on a sensitive 5G-security decision. That is a real transparency weak point, even if it does not prove bad faith. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.4`.

- [Bundesverfassungsgericht - The Federal Intelligence Service’s powers to conduct strategic surveillance of international telecommunications for the purpose of detecting cyber threats are unconstitutional in part](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) · Bundesverfassungsgericht · 8 Nov 2024 · The Court found parts of BND strategic-surveillance powers unconstitutional and said oversight was inadequate. This is structural counterevidence: the state’s independent oversight architecture remained too weak in 2024. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.2`, `7B.4`.

- [Streit um Cum-ex-Untersuchungsausschuss: Kanzleramt muss geheimes Rechtsgutachten offenlegen](https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/streit-um-cum-ex-untersuchungsausschuss-kanzleramt-muss-geheimes-rechtsgutachten-offenlegen-11215801.html) · Tagesspiegel · 16 Feb 2024 · Reporting suggested the Chancellery had an internal legal memo aimed at blunting the CDU push for a Bundestag inquiry into the Warburg affair. This is the strongest sign of an attempt to contain scrutiny around a conflict-of-interest allegation. IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.4`, `7B.2`.

**Search gap**

I found no 2024 evidence that Scholz blocked access to his assets, campaign finance, or private interests through outright intimidation or formal suppression. The negative material is mostly about opacity, memory-gap testimony, and weak oversight, not a proven campaign against independent investigators.
